text:
cheng: hey folks, seeing a memory growth regression in kvcache when running long-context chat workloads on H100 vs MI250. looks like pagedattn paths allocate more pages and never reclaim under sustained longctx (>100k tokens). logs + traces attached below :eyes:

maria: can you paste the repro? is it deterministic?

cheng: minimal repro: run test_longctx_paged.sh from perfbench, 4 sessions concurrently, seq_len ramp to 64k. observed vram climb until oom on MI250 after ~18m. no oom on H100 but much higher fragmentation.

cheng: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-17T12:34:21Z INFO kvcache: alloc_page gid=0x7f4a size=1MB owner=pt shard=3
2026-03-17T12:34:21Z WARN kvcache: evict_failed reason=owner_mismatch page=0x7f4a
2026-03-17T12:38:42Z INFO pagetable: remap page=0x7f4a -> 0x8b2c stale_owner=true
```

aj: owner_mismatch + stale_owner rings like a remap / tombstone handling bug. we saw similar on RTX/AMD mismatch before when kernel selection changed page-walk ordering. :thinking:

tom: I ran nsight/perf on an MI250 run. eviction_count spikes line up with pagewalk stalls. attaching flame: most time in kvcache::walk_back and pagetable::coalesce.

olivia: what's the reuse window config for the run? we recently pushed a heuristic that extends reuse window for longctx which may interact badly with tiling-based eviction.

cheng: config: reuse_window=8192, eviction_bias=fragmentation_age, tiling=sectorized (this is the new default on MI250 to favor sparse maps).

maria: sectorized tiling + extended reuse seems prime for fragmentation. but stale_owner traces suggest we also have a race where remap leaves tombstones that bypass coalesce.

aj: hypothesis: on MI250 the kernel selector picks the tiled pagewalk kernel which uses async free-list writes. race between free-list update and subsequent coalesce can leave entries orphaned. on CUDA path we pick a sync kernel that avoids the window.

cheng: good call. I repro'd locally by toggling kernel_mode=tiled_async vs tiled_sync. tiled_async shows the leak. tiled_sync reclaims fine.

tom: can you attach the perf counters? I have eviction_count, free_list_ops, remap_ops for both modes.

cheng: pasted numbers:
- tiled_async: eviction_count=12.3k, free_list_ops/sec=2.1k, remap_ops/sec=1.7k, orphan_pages=314
- tiled_sync: eviction_count=11.9k, free_list_ops/sec=2.9k, remap_ops/sec=1.8k, orphan_pages=6

olivia: wild. tiled_async lower free_list_ops but more orphan_pages -> suggests missed free updates. could be a missing memory_fence or an ordering bug in the tiled kernel.

maria: also noticed the pagetable coalesce code walks buckets in different order depending on arch word size; that could expose a use-after-free ordering when remap flips owners.

aj: plan: bisect kernel selector to confirm switchpoint. if repro toggles with kernel_mode flag that's enough to blame the kernel impl. I'll start a bisection across commits that introduced tiled_async selection for ROCm.

maria: I'll add a small stress test that flips kernel_mode every 30s to amplify races and run it on CI-MI250. if it fails, we capture repro artifact.

infra-bot: perf-ci job kvcache-longctx-stress triggered: job/4217 started on mi250-08 (config: reuse_window=8192, tiling=flipping).

tom: also curious about page-table slot compaction heuristics. if compaction is deferred under high load it may postpone coalesce and accumulate tombstones. any telemetry there?

cheng: telemetry shows compaction_delay spikes during the growth period. compaction_lock contention rises ~x3.

olivia: probably because tiled_async reduces throughput of free_list writers, compaction can't keep up -> backlog -> fragmentation explosion. we should either force compaction more eagerly or make free-list updates idempotent and visible across kernels.

aj: immediate mitigation: toggle kernel selector to prefer tiled_sync on MI250 for release build until fix. also add an assert in remap path to detect stale_owner leaks early.

maria: I'll open PR with stress test + assert + a small telemetry counter for orphan_pages. will also run on H100 to ensure no perf regression.

cheng: I'll prepare a mini repro and share NV/ROCm traces in the issue. tagging @aj @maria for follow-ups. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

aj: copying action items:
- bisect tiled_async selector (aj)
- PR: stress test + assert + orphan telemetry (maria)
- short-term switch to tiled_sync on MI250 (cheng + infra)
- collect nsight/rocprof traces and counters (tom)

maria: started a branch: refs/heads/kvcache/orphan-detect-7432, pushing test now.

infra-bot: job/4217 update: failure reproduced, collected artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/ci/4217/artifacts.tar.gz

cheng: awesome repro. I'll attach the artifacts to the issue and mark as P1. we'll aim for fix this week.

olivia: if we change default selector, let's add a rollout flag and telemetry so we can flip back if something else breaks.

maria: agreed. adding a runtime rollout flag + metric.

aj: will post bisect results here when ready.

maria: thanks all, keeping thread open for updates.
